Weekly planning app for small teams

Example turns a list of tasks into a plan for the week. Everyone sees what they are doing today, and what comes next, without a status meeting.

How planning works

Add the tasks for the week, set who owns each one, and the planner spreads them across the days so that no one is overloaded. Read the guide to planning a week for the details, or compare the plans and prices.

Who it is for

Teams of three to thirty people who plan together every Monday, and want the plan to survive until Friday.

Every plan is saved as you go.
